description: This source file implements telemetry data model processing, including JSON parsing, message queue handling, and thread management for report profiles in a telemetry system.

methods.name: process_rp_thread
methods.description: Thread function to process report profiles JSON objects from rpQueue.

methods.name: process_tmprp_thread
methods.description: Thread function to process temporary report profiles JSON objects from tmpRpQueue.

methods.name: process_msg_thread
methods.description: Thread function to process message pack blobs from rpMsgPkgQueue.

methods.name: datamodel_processProfile
methods.description: Validates JSON, checks for 'profiles' field, and enqueues the JSON object for processing.

methods.name: datamodel_getSavedJsonProfilesasString
methods.description: Retrieves saved JSON profiles as a string.

methods.name: datamodel_getSavedMsgpackProfilesasString
methods.description: Retrieves saved message pack profiles as a string.

methods.name: datamodel_MsgpackProcessProfile
methods.description: Enqueues a message pack blob for processing.

methods.name: datamodel_init
methods.description: Initializes queues, mutexes, condition variables, and starts processing threads.

methods.name: datamodel_unInit
methods.description: Stops processing threads and cleans up resources.
